text: In February 2021, following public and community consultation, residents reached out to my office with an urgent concern about speeding along their street and requested via an online survey that traffic calming measures (speed humps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns. Unanimously, the residents that responded were in support of making this change. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Laughton Avenue from Davenport Road to Kingsley Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Laughton Avenue, between Davenport Road and Kingsley Avenue. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Laughton Avenue, between Davenport Road and Kingsley Avenue, to install three speed humps, generally as shown on the copy of 'Drawing No. 421G-4045' dated May 2022 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services, attached to the letter (May 26, 2022) from Councillor Ana Bailão, Ward 9, Davenport.
